description: Find candidate LEIs by legal-entity name in GLEIF's global LEI index. Supply query; optionally limit results. Returns candidate LEIs and matching legal names, jurisdictions and statuses. Select and verify a candidate, then use lookup_lei for its record. Matching is not identity certification; LEI issuance or status is not proof of financial soundness. Price: $0.0051 production USDC via x402 on Base mainnet. Example arguments: {"query":"Apple Inc","limit":5}.
name: search_lei
